request.prompt: Use the supplied reference logo as the exact design family to develop. This is YAML rhythm, the chosen logo direction for zals, a Zig Ansible Language Server. It has exactly THREE separate wide horizontal geometric ribbons: a long top row, a shorter deliberately indented middle row, and a long bottom row. Their angled terminals imply a broken Z. Keep this wonderfully simple three-row rhythm. Do not introduce a connected Z, icon container, extra parts, badges, code brackets, lettering, dots, outlines, line art, or a wordmark. Preserve the reference's broad weights, generous open gaps, and legibility as a 16px icon. Create ONE new polished multicolor variant using exactly TWO flat ink colors within the actual logo, not a monochrome silhouette or just a colored background. Each ribbon should remain a single large flat color area; do not add little stripes or intricate subdivisions. Crisp vector-like geometric contours, optically balanced. No gradients, no shadows, no texture, no 3D or lighting, no transparency effects inside the mark. Place the single icon centered on a pure white (#FFFFFF) plain background with ample margin, approximately 75% canvas occupancy. The particular variation and its precise color palette are: Zig-inspired amber #F0A12A and graphite #25313A. Top and bottom ribbons are graphite; the shorter middle ribbon is amber. Make the top-right and bottom-left terminal cuts slightly steeper than the reference, keeping all three strokes bold, separate, and horizontal. A tiny bit more forward energy, no extra shapes.
